data.title: 希耶尔 · 晨光白幔间的静谧羞赧
data.description: 清晨的柔和天光穿透教堂宿舍的亚麻白帘，希耶尔摘下眼镜放在床头木柜上，坐在铺着素色床单的床沿轻理着白色过膝袜缘。察觉到视线落在纯白花纹蕾丝上时，她轻轻咬住下唇，耳根泛起淡淡红晕，却没有躲闪。
data.location: 晨光微透的简约欧式寝室床边
data.action: 坐在床沿整理白丝袜口，摘下眼镜羞赧抬头相望
data.lighting: 穿透白窗帘的清澈漫射晨光，凸显蕾丝织纹与细腻肤色
data.camera: 平视中景，床头眼镜与素白床幔入画
data.promptProse: With her glasses set neatly on the wooden nightstand, Ciel sits at the edge of the sun-dappled bed smoothing the top of her white thigh-high stockings. Soft morning light filtering through white linen curtains illuminates the floral embroidery of her white lace lingerie as she meets the viewer's eyes with a gentle blush.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the sunlit bed with her glasses on the nightstand, she adjusts her white thigh-high stockings while blushing softly.
data.nsfwProse: Delicate white floral lace and matching garter straps frame her figure cleanly in the translucent morning light.
